column1: # Accepted islands of the world island test (ksim_nav_islands, docs/formats/NAVMESH_CACHE.md "Island test").
# A line is keyed by what the island is (kenshi-k16.7.66), not where its centroid falls: record = the owning building's id, or open world@ZX,ZZ
# (the zone of the centroid); floor_y = the floor's height above the placement's y (the absolute height in the open world), matched within 8 u;
# area in u2, matched within a factor of 1.3. x, z: where the island was when the line was written (for a human, never matched).
# One line covers one island: a second island of the same key is NEW.
# source: shipped (the original's own navtile), rebaked (a tile our loader replaced: a stale or unverifiable zone or
# interior), mixed (the island spans both). accepted: the original has the same island (or it is not a place that should
# be reached). bug: the original's own tile connects this floor to its main mesh, ours does not (kenshi-k16.7.53: listed for a bake
# fix, not a failure). pending: its class needs the original's behaviour to decide (none left). Decided by `ksim_nav_islands --oracle`.
